# Matrix Reprogrammed Master Upgrade Spec

## Mission

Matrix Reprogrammed is a living public-record intelligence system. It maps how power moves through people, elite families, institutions, governments, jurisdictions, tax havens, banks, asset managers, think tanks, secret societies, media networks, policy systems, financial routes, intelligence/security structures, narrative systems, legal structures, missing records, and convergence signals.

The site must help readers understand who is in power, who the elite are, what institutions they operate through, what policies are being advanced, what money routes and jurisdictions are used, what think tanks and organisations influence policy, what public records prove, what the evidence suggests, what remains unproven, what records are missing, what changed today, and what the reader should investigate next.

## Core Rule

Never present speculation as fact.

Every page must separate documented fact, sourced analysis, reasonable inference, speculation, unsupported claim, and missing record.

Evidence boundary used across the site:

> Inclusion means public-record research relevance. It does not prove wrongdoing, secret control, criminal conduct, shared intent, or conspiracy. Claims must be checked against sources and evidence boundaries.

## Final Standard

The finished site should feel like a 10/10 intelligence platform. It should tell the reader who is in power, who the elite are, what they are doing, what institutions they use, what policies are advancing, what money routes matter, what jurisdictions matter, what evidence exists, what is missing, what changed, what to watch next, what to read, what to download, what to buy or join.

The site must become a living public-record intelligence system, not a static website.

## Required System Layers

1. Full site quality and page finish audit
2. Daily command brief
3. Site brain router
4. Review dashboard
5. Power map
6. Nine 52-card decks
7. Direct deep dossiers
8. Source ledger
9. Missing-record queue
10. Risk clocks
11. Conclusion engine
12. Search system
13. Cross-reference map
14. Store, membership, reports, books and custom research funnels
15. Monetisation dashboard
16. Daily update log and stale-source log
17. Trust/legal boundary on all people, family, institution, society, policy and jurisdiction pages
18. Build/deploy audit with high-severity failure rules

## Monetisation Logic

Traffic -> email capture -> free brief/download -> membership/report/deck/book/custom research.

Revenue layers:

- Free public layer
- Email capture layer
- Membership layer
- Premium reports
- Card deck products
- Books
- Custom public-record research

## Audit Rule

Do not claim the site is complete unless the latest full audit passes. Do not claim production deploy is complete unless production deploy is confirmed.
